strongest_bounded_proposition: Early-thirteenth-century descriptions of Champa report people being bought and made slaves, supporting a bounded slavery/slave-market claim near 1300.
strongest_unsupported_proposition: Do not infer territorial prevalence across all Champa from market/transaction evidence.
territorial_practice_summary: Slave purchasing/enslavement supported near the anchor period.
external_network_summary: Commercial evidence does not quantify local prevalence.
temporal_scope_precision: Direct account is early thirteenth century; broad c.1300 relevance only.
language_access_limitations: English-accessible packet only; non-English/non-digitized scholarship not exhaustively searched.
